lines: Every problem you solve makes the next one a little easier — keep going!
I've seen a lot of students pass through here. You're doing great.
Mistakes are just the first draft of getting it right.
That streak of yours is looking good — don't stop now!
Numbers are just puzzles waiting for a curious mind like yours.
There's a shortcut past the orange tile — if you can earn it.
I once got stuck on a problem like that for a whole afternoon. You'll get it faster than I did.
The boots up ahead belong to whoever keeps their streak alive.
Math is just another kind of map-reading, if you think about it.
Onward! There's always another puzzle past the next hill.
I light the way, but you do the thinking — that's the deal.
Slow and correct beats fast and wrong, every time.
You've leveled up more than you realize.
A good hint is worth more than a given answer. Use them wisely.
Rest if you need to. The path will still be here.
